observation.happening: Success notification toast confirming screen recording configuration completion
observation.most_important: Green checkmark and positive message clearly signal successful action completion
observation.next_action: User can dismiss via × button, interact with circular icon button on right, or await auto-dismiss
anomalies: Circular icon button with vertical bars on right side—its purpose and relationship to the confirmation message is unexplained and unclear within this frame alone
Absence of context makes it ambiguous whether the button is a control for the recording or an unrelated element

EFA1.why: Well-executed notification toast with clear success messaging, compact density, and calm presentation. Green checkmark, Japanese text, and layout are professional and polished. However, the rightmost circular button introduces ambiguity—its role and necessity in a confirmation toast are unclear, detracting from pure clarity. Additionally, the pattern itself (checkmark + message + close button) is standard across many products, lacking the distinctiveness expected of SUPREME-tier design.
